column1: # Structural rules for frame lines that are closed grammars: every part that varies is a fixed
# alternation, a date or a cue between parentheses. ADR-0008 5.3: a rule matches the whole line or
# sentence, anchored at both ends, and its variable part is a closed list. Open slots (a topic, a
# question to the reader, a headword and its definition) were tried and rejected; see ADR-0008
# Notes. The one exception to "closed list" is the cue line, whose boundary is not a regex guess:
# the text itself marks it (the parentheses), and the closed part (a keyword and a colon) alone
# Tab-separated: scope, kind, flags (i = ignore case), regex.

# sentence matched against the normalised sentence (lower case, no commas, slots such as

)
#   line      matched against the whole line as written
